Sam: Heads-up — I'm seeing a regression on mixtral-8x (dedicated) when serving very long contexts. Perplexity spikes around ~20k tokens and token throughput drops. Kernel picker flips mid-run.
Maria: Can you paste the perf trace and config? Is this on Dedicated or Hosted?
Sam: Dedicated (p3.8xlarge), runtime v1.42, kernel-picker=enabled, adaptive-batcher=on, quant=dynamic-int8. Repro steps: run longctx-harness --model mixtral-8x --rope-mode ntk-linear-hybrid --seq 32768 --batch 1
Sam: Trace snippet: ```
[19000] kernel_select: fast_attn_packed -> fallback_sparse_slice
[19002] gpu_kernel_ms: 1.6 -> 5.8
[19002] memcpy_host_to_device_ms: 0.2 -> 1.4
[19002] kv_slots_used: 24576/262144 -> 24569 (eviction events: 3)
```
Jordan: That looks like a head_kv packing mismatch causing a fallback kernel that isn't optimized for our head/KV layout. What are head_kv and num_heads?
Sam: head_kv=64, num_heads=32, kv_dim = head_kv * num_heads = 2048. Quant profile uses per-channel int8 with packed-heads expectation. The fallback is a sliced-kernel that expects head_kv=48 packing.
Taylor: Two angles: 1) isolate batching noise by forcing --adaptive-batcher=off and --kernel=force-packed to see if the regression is kernel-policy related. 2) RoPE scaling: NTK variants can drift in attention for long ranges — try lowering the scale factor (0.95 or 0.9) past 16k token warmup to prevent attention cutoff causing more KV churn.
Maria: I ran a quick micro-run with --kernel=force-packed and adaptive-batcher=off. Result: no latency cliff, but perplexity still drifts slightly at 24k. KV occupancy trace shows a small leak: ```
kv_occupancy: 0.937 -> 0.934 every 512 tokens (delta -0.003)
leak_source: slot_reuse_timeout (approx 2s)
```
Maria: So both kernel fallback and KV eviction are contributing. The fallback multiplies per-token latency; the leak increases memory pressure and triggers subsequent fallbacks.
Felix-bot: runtime-ci queued perf job 12345 for mixtral-8x longctx (ntk-linear-hybrid) — will post results in ~45m.
runtime-ci: job 12345: p95 token latency baseline 1.9ms -> current 3.8ms (mid-run cliff).
Jordan: Proposed short-term mitigations: 
- bump kernel-picker policy to prefer-packed-with-fallback-threshold=0.8 (reduce aggressive switching)
- set rope-scaling-profile: mixtral-8x: ntk up to 16k, hybrid-yarn beyond 16k with linear interpolation to avoid sudden spectral changes
- KV hygiene: increase slot-retention to 4s for longctx mode to avoid premature eviction
Jordan: Proposed safe ranges (initial guess, needs benchmarking): 
- Mixtral-8x: NTK scale safe up to 16k with head_kv=64; between 16k-32k prefer yarn-hybrid; >32k use linear-with-interp and heavier KV retention.
- Mistral-7b: prefer linear RoPE; head_kv=48 safe up to 8k.
- Llama-family (70B): conservative NTK up to 12k, check per-model evals.
Taylor: I'll open an experiment PR that forces these policy tweaks behind a toggle and adds a perf job matrix across head_kv {48,64} and rope-scale {1.0,0.95,0.9} for mixtral/mistral/llama/qwen. Also adding a microbench that measures memcpy and kernel change rate per 1k tokens.
Sam: Thanks — will run evaluation with our quality harness (perplexity + longform PPL segments) once PR lands. If pattern holds we should surface per-model "safe range" suggestions in Optimize and Console prompts.
Maria: One more CI gate suggestion: block rollouts if perplexity delta > 2% AND p50 token latency increase > 1.5ms for any longctx scenario.
Jordan: Agreed. Also add a metric for kernel-switch-rate (switches per 10k tokens) to alert when >1.
Sam: Assigning to @Sam and @Jordan to coordinate experiments. I'll paste links to perf artifacts when done.
Maria: :thumbsup:
